title: タンパク質工学
subtitle: Protein Engineering
educationalGoal: This course will provide students with knowledge of protein engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basic of protein engineering. The second is to introduce the applications of protein engineering.
advice:
This course will include the following topics:

1) Basic of protein engineering
Protein conformation (amino acids, conformation, etc.)
Purification (Protein extraction, protein purification, etc.)
Enzyme (Reaction kinetics, coenzymes, inhibitors)

 2) Application of protein engineering
Strategies for protein overproduction
Enzyme engineering
books:
Textbooks：Essential Protein Engineering (Kodansha)
Reference books：Genetic Engineering 2nd ed.
Reserved books：Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: This course deals with the extension of the topics you learn in the “Basic Biology”, “Bioengineering” and “Gene Engineering” courses. Knowledge of nucleic acids and proteins is required.

              This course will provide students with knowledge of protein engineering. This course has two aims. The first is to teach students the basic of protein engineering. The second is to introduce the applications of protein engineering.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course will include the following topics:

1) Basic of protein engineering
Protein conformation (amino acids, conformation, etc.)
Purification (Protein extraction, protein purification, etc.)
Enzyme (Reaction kinetics, coenzymes, inhibitors)

 2) Application of protein engineering
Strategies for protein overproduction
Enzyme engineering

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbooks：Essential Protein Engineering (Kodansha)
Reference books：Genetic Engineering 2nd ed.
Reserved books：Unspecified

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course deals with the extension of the topics you learn in the “Basic Biology”, “Bioengineering” and “Gene Engineering” courses. Knowledge of nucleic acids and proteins is required.
